配布 UDF の入出力と、意図的に計算していないもの: Distributed UDF inputs and outputs, and what is intentionally not calculated

Record unverifiable paths as unverified, and also check Japanese charts for missing labels. Keep these results separate from Core evaluation and conduct the 10 questions after adding the tool as a separate record.
